evidence.red_green_non_vacuous: RED: a copy of paper #3's manuscripts dir with one well-formed uncited entry appended to REFERENCES.bib -> tool exit 1, message "R18 FAILED: uncited=['uncited_probe_2099'] unknown=[] bibitems=14 bibkeys=14", which names the probe key. GREEN: same copy with the entry removed -> exit 0 and main.tex sha256 90db2cd4...c9b86 == shipped. Non-vacuity proven by mutation, not assertion: scratch/umdtex1/mut/md2tex_mut.py disables guard_citations ('if False and (missing or unknown or bibitems != len(bib_keys))') and the same red scenario then exits 0 and writes a main.tex carrying 1 \bibitem{uncited_probe_2099} and 0 \cite{uncited_probe_2099}. So the red assertion genuinely detects an absent guard rather than an incidental error.

evidence.config_deviation: The card asked for per-paper values in a TOML under orchestration/packages/. I did NOT do that: that path is outside this unit's declared write paths AND orchestration/packages/<slug>.toml are UBUILD1's own schema=1 build manifests consumed by tools/package/check_manifest.py, so adding md2tex keys there would be an undeclared write plus a foreign-schema edit. Instead per-paper values are the pure-data PACKAGES registry inside tools/package/md2tex.py (keyed by slug). Migration, documented in the tool docstring and README: lift PACKAGES verbatim to orchestration/packages/<slug>/md2tex.toml and load with tomllib; no logic change, every value is already data.
